name: quoxtrade
tagline: The trading desk that shows its working
description: A governed, evidenced trading desk. Around 80 market indicators with explicit trigger levels, a Missing Stars regime score, a five-agent Quant desk that reasons over your live signals, and a human-approved, fully audited order loop. Paper today, wired for live execution on your own exchange. Non-custodial: your keys, your exchange, and it runs on your OAuth CLI with no metered API keys.
shortDescription: An evidenced trading cockpit. The desk proposes, you approve, and every step is audited.
author: Quox
marketingPoints: Around 80 indicators, each with an explicit numeric buy/sell trigger level. No black boxes
Missing Stars: what still needs to happen, not buy now
A five-agent Quant desk that reasons over your live signals
Governed order loop: the desk proposes, you approve, it fills. Every step is audited
A server-side kill switch and per-order risk caps sit in front of every fill
Non-custodial: your keys, your exchange. Quox never holds funds
